request: Inspect active bounded Host receiver/writer versions after terminal source reflection

bounded_host_request.command: set -e; cd /home/admin1/server-core; printf 'HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD; printf 'WRITER='; systemctl --user is-active gace-servercore-service-deploy.service || true; printf 'SINK='; systemctl --user is-active gace-servercore-result-sink.service || true; docker inspect --format 'RECEIVER={{.Name}} IMAGE={{.Config.Image}} STATUS={{.State.Status}}' server-core-bounded-host; printf 'RECEIVER_PY_DIGEST='; docker exec server-core-bounded-host sha256sum /app/scripts/servercore_bounded_host_receiver.py | cut -d ' ' -f1; printf 'HOST_PY_DIGEST='; sha256sum scripts/servercore_bounded_host_receiver.py | cut -d ' ' -f1; ls -la .env .env.project-control 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $9}' || true
